usageNotes: Use this to create a named IP or CIDR alias in a specific LXC container's firewall scope, allowing firewall rules for that container to reference human-readable names instead of raw addresses. The caller must hold VM.Config.Network on /vms/{vmid}. Returns null on success — no UPID is issued; the alias is applied synchronously.

examples.summary: Create an alias named 'mgmt-net' pointing to the management subnet for LXC 110 on node pve1

tips: Alias names must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores (min 2, max 64 chars).
Aliases defined here are container-scoped — they are not visible to other VMs or to the datacenter/cluster firewall alias pool.
After creation, reference the alias by name in container firewall rules using the 'source' or 'dest' fields.
To update an alias, use the PUT sibling endpoint; this POST will error if the name already exists.
